    StartersFried picklesHalf-sours in rye batter. Pickles come with every tableHow to make it4 half-sour or dill pickles80g plain flour40g rye flour1/2 tsp paprika150ml cold soda water1 L vegetable oil100g mayonnaise2 tbsp yellow mustardCut the pickles into spears and pat them very dry. Keep a teaspoon of the brine.Whisk the plain flour, rye flour, paprika and cold soda water into a thin batter.Dip the spears and fry at 180°C for about 2 minutes until crisp, in batches. Drain on a rack and salt lightly.Stir the mayonnaise with the mustard and the pickle brine and serve alongside.MainsChef saladExactly as she orders itHow to make it4 eggs2 cos lettuces200g sliced leg ham200g sliced turkey150g swiss cheese, cut into strips2 tomatoes, sliced1/2 cucumber, sliced60ml olive oil30ml red wine vinegarHard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.Wash the cos lettuces, dry well and tear into a large platter.Arrange the leg ham, turkey, swiss cheese strips, halved eggs, tomatoes and cucumber in rows over the lettuce.Pour the olive oil and red wine vinegar into two little jugs and serve them on the side.Pastrami on ryeThe Katz's classic. Hand cut, piled high, a pickle on the sideHow to make it600g sliced pastrami8 slices of seeded rye bread40g yellow mustard4 full sour dill picklesSteam the pastrami over gently boiling water until glossy, soft and piping hot.Spread the rye with mustard.Pile the pastrami high on four slices and close the sandwiches.Serve each with a pickle on the side.SweetsApple pie à la modeOn the side. All of itHow to make it600g ready-baked apple pie300ml strawberry ice cream, or 150ml thickened cream if unavailableCut four slices from the pie.Warm on a tray at 180°C.Serve with the strawberry ice cream in a separate small bowl beside each slice.DrinksChocolate egg creamThe lady at the next table will have what you're havingHow to make it120ml chocolate syrup400ml full cream milk, ice cold1 L soda water, ice coldPour 30ml chocolate syrup into each of four tall glasses and add 100ml ice cold milk.Blast the soda water in hard from a height until the foam reaches the rim, stirring fast with a long spoon as it goes. Serve straight away. No egg, no cream.
